# Math Review for MDS

Welcome to MDS! We hope this math review will help you refresh your memory on core concepts from calculus and linear algebra, and prepare you to apply these concepts in the context of data science and machine learning.

This website is not intended as a standalone textbook or course; mostly it just links to existing free and open source materials. The "modules" organize these materials for ease-of-use: under each you will find a brief conceptual introduction, links to selected videos and some exercises. The "Reference Material" section contains a more detailed list of resources. You can access this section using the navigation pane on the left, or by clicking the arrow at the bottom right of the current page.

We hope you find this website useful, and encourage you to return to it throughout the program as needed to reinforce your understanding.
